name: openspec_validate_change
description: Run `openspec validate <id> --strict` for real without raising on failure, so the post-merge verification loop can fold spec validity into its pass/fail gate and let the fixup pass correct a broken proposal/design/specs/tasks.md instead of crashing later at archive time.

skip.description: When present and not one of true/1/yes/on, skip validation entirely and report {valid:true, skipped:true} (generic document plan). Absent or truthy runs validation.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the git repo to run `openspec validate` in. Required unless skip is truthy.

changeId.description: OpenSpec change id to validate. Required unless skip is truthy.

valid.description: True when validation was skipped, or the `openspec validate` process exited 0.

skipped.description: True when validation was skipped because `skip` was falsy; present only on the skip path.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the `openspec validate` process; 0 on the skip path.

issues.description: Validation issues reported for the change; empty when valid or skipped.

log.description: Trailing combined stdout+stderr of the validate process (last 8000 chars); empty on the skip path.
